QuestInfo.name: Ariant Coliseum
QuestInfo.1: With a grim face, #p2101018# told you that only the determined can enter the #bColiseum Arena#k. He wouldn't tell you what it was, but he said you could enter if you had no fear.
QuestInfo.2: #p2101009#'s is holding a Royal Hunt! That's what the #b#m260000000# Coliseum#k is all about about. #bHunting monsters to create jewels in a competitive match between adventurers#k? Sounds fun!

0.0: Hmm? Do you wish to participate in the Coliseum? Then register for it over here. I warn you though, those who aren't prepared won't be able to participate in... What was that? What's a Coliseum? You've never heard of the Coliseum?
0.1: Hmm! It's a hunting festival only for the most courageous adventurers. But I don't think you'd be interested. Come to the Coliseum Arena to prove you're brave enough.

yes.0: If you have enough courage to come to the Coliseum Arena, I'll give you more details about the competition.

no.0: I knew you were a coward.

0.0: Hmm? Do you wish to participate in the #bColiseum#k? Then register for it over here. I warn you though, those who aren't prepared won't be able to participate in... What was that? What's a Coliseum? You've never heard of the Coliseum?
0.1: Hmm! It's a hunting festival only for the most courageous adventurers. But I don't think you'd be interested. You look too weak and faint-hearted to be an adventurer.
0.2: I take it from your face that I have offended you. It doesn't change the fact that only skilled warriors have a chance in the #bColiseum Arena#k. If you think you have what it takes, go and prove yourself.

yes.0: If you have enough courage to come to the Coliseum Arena, I'll give you more details about the competition.

no.0: I knew you were a coward.

1.0: Hmm. Judging by the fact that you made it here, you must be pretty bold. But do you think you'll still be brave enough after I explain what the #b#m260000000# Coliseum#k is about?
1.1: The #m260000000# is a Royal Hunting Competition arranged on the order of his majesty, #p2101009#. But unlike normal hunting competitions, it is not just about hunting down monsters. It is also about using Element Rocks to make jewels.
1.2: You'd be making a big mistake, thinking it's easy. You need the skills to control your hits. You need sharp eyes to discern the situation. And you a strong will to create a jewel in one try. Without any of this, the hunt will be impossible.
1.3: And this competition involves #bgoing up against other adventurers who will match your skills#k! Even a decent adventurer will have a hard time winning.

yes.0: But I will commend you for not running away with your tail between your legs. I'm still not sure you'll be able to cut it in the competition. Nothing is for certain. If you want to prove yourself, test yourself in the #bColiseum#k!

npc.0: As I thought, you can't even step into the #bColiseum Arena#k. Coward.
